Build the settings page

For a coding agent · 72 words

Build the Settings page for Your product in this codebase.

What it is for: let an owner rename the workspace and choose who can invite people.

Use only these components: page header (default), text field, segmented control, button (primary, quiet).
States: default, saving, error ("The name is already taken").

Done when:
- Every state renders and is reachable with the keyboard alone.
- No raw colour, size or duration values; every value comes from a token.

Built from Button, Card, Code block, Dialog, Popover menu, Segmented control
